edits.new:
VERSION="$1"

# Honor an explicit bounded build budget; use two jobs by default.
BUILD_JOBS="${CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL:-2}"
case "$BUILD_JOBS" in
  0*|*[!0-9]*) echo "CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL must be a positive integer" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

# The Python source archive already contains the complete pinned Abseil tree.
  # Reject a partial local tree; preserve the upstream fetch when it is absent.
  set(_spm_bundled_absl "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/abseil-cpp")
  if (EXISTS "${_spm_bundled_absl}")
    if (NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${_spm_bundled_absl}"
        OR NOT EXISTS "${_spm_bundled_absl}/CMakeLists.txt"
        OR IS_DIRECTORY "${_spm_bundled_absl}/CMakeLists.txt"
        OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${_spm_bundled_absl}/absl"
        OR NOT EXISTS "${_spm_bundled_absl}/absl/base/config.h"
        OR IS_DIRECTORY "${_spm_bundled_absl}/absl/base/config.h")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled Abseil source tree is incomplete")
    endif()
  else()
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Populate(abseil-cpp
          GIT_REPOSITORY  https://github.com/abseil/abseil-cpp.git
          SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/abseil-cpp
          GIT_PROGRESS TRUE
          GIT_TAG 20260526.0)
  endif()
edits.old:
include(FetchContent)
  FetchContent_Populate(abseil-cpp

        GIT_PROGRESS TRUE
